description: This file contains utility functions and data classes for JSON parsing, color processing, error handling, and string normalization used within the 'ai.openclaw.app.node' package. It provides support functions for JSON manipulation, color conversion, error extraction, and string handling that facilitate the operation of other components in the project.

classes.name: Quad
classes.description: A generic data class representing a four-tuple with elements of types A, B, C, and D.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Converts a string into a JSON-escaped string, escaping backslashes, quotes, and control characters.

methods.name: asObjectOrNull
methods.description: Safely casts a JsonElement to a JsonObject if possible, returning null otherwise.

methods.name: parseJsonParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, returning null if the input is null, blank, or invalid JSON.

methods.name: readJsonPrimitive
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonPrimitive from a JsonObject by key, returning null if not present or not a primitive.

methods.name: parseJsonInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from a JsonObject by key, returning null if not available or invalid.

methods.name: parseJsonDouble
methods.description: Extracts a double value from a JsonObject by key, returning null if not available or invalid.

methods.name: parseJsonString
methods.description: Extracts a string value from a JsonObject by key, returning null if not available.

methods.name: parseJsonBooleanFlag
methods.description: Extracts a boolean flag from a JsonObject by key, interpreting 'true'/'false' strings.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Returns the string content of a JsonElement if it is a JsonPrimitive or null if JsonNull.

methods.name: parseHexColorArgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color string (with optional '#') into a Long ARGB color value, including alpha channel.

methods.name: invokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Extracts a code-message pair from a Throwable using external error parsing, with fallback message.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Trims a raw string to produce a normalized main key or null if empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a key is exactly 'main', indicating a canonical main session key.
